provider_sources.evidence: PUT /projects/:id/issues/:issue_iid accepts numeric project ID, title, description, comma-separated add_labels and remove_labels. add_labels creates a project label if the name does not exist. labels replaces the set. updated_at sets the time with elevated rights; it is not an expected revision.
Title, Description, AddLabels, RemoveLabels are supported; UpdateIssue uses HTTP PUT with project ID and IID. No expected revision field.
Issue PUT selects by project and issue IID and calls Issues::UpdateService; its declared parameters do not expose expected revision or lock_version.
On scoped-label tiers, adding key::value replaces a previous same-key label. The product requires explicit removal of the previous label and rejects multiple same-scope additions.
Updates interpret quick actions from effective description and merge command parameters. The product rejects slash-leading description lines rather than allow this implicit mutation channel.

concurrency.race: Concurrent issue changes can be overwritten after checks; deleted/renamed label names can be recreated or reused. Postchecks detect observed divergence, not exclusive authorship, and never roll back.

test_scope: Pinned official package against local TLS synthetic endpoints only. Verifies GET/PUT argv, JSON label-name deltas, numeric project target, output/credential bounds, and exactly one attempt for success, rejection, throttling, server failure, malformed/lost response, redirects, timeout and cancellation. Does not claim a live GitLab integration test.
